items.summary: CRO evidence note: the markitdown repository is MIT-licensed and passed bounded read-only lab checks, making a disposable document-to-Markdown prototype plausible for structured SEO-content workflows. The smallest reversible prototype is offline conversion of a fixed sample set with human review, no production dependency or deployment. Expected metric: reviewed conversion accuracy and time-to-draft; time-to-learn: one isolated lab cycle. Risks: dependency and parser security review, maintenance/version drift, document privacy, and no proof of search or revenue lift. Keep prototype-only until CTO/security and measurement gates clear.
